title: Leyla's wedding and the old roles

notes: Formulation A, domain culture_values (ChronoCulture: values, generations, gender roles). Ten meaning units: Leyla plans her wedding / her grandmother expects a traditional ceremony / Leyla keeps her surname / her father criticises this / her fiancé Emre cooks the feast with his brothers / the aunts argue about old customs / grandfather defends the old roles / her younger sister supports Leyla / her grandmother accepts Leyla's choice / the couple celebrates on Saturday. Subjects alternate between the protagonist (Leyla), relatives of three generations (grandmother, father, fiancé, aunts, grandfather, sister) and 'the couple', singular and plural, so C3 switches cross real agreement. Unit 7 uses bare 'Grandfather' / 'Großvater' as a name-like subject (family register). No separable German verbs ('vorbereiten', 'zustimmen', 'stattfinden' avoided). Proper names: Leyla and Emre, identical in both languages (genitive 'Leylas' in unit 9). Present tense, positive polarity; unit 9 reads naturally in German, units 1 and 10 in English.
